interpretation: The categorical calibration ceiling is representation-wide rather than driven by one trait or a few families: 8/9 categorical traits have >=80% S3 no-bracket rates, 4/9 are 100%, and among 83 families with at least two categorical systems the median and IQR family no-bracket rate are all 100%.
interpretation_guard: Breadth supports a measurement/representation bottleneck only, not weaker biological phylogenetic signal in categorical traits.
